history.summary: A compact 1,227sqft 4BR at $2.459M / $2,004 PSF, 170m from Tampines West DTL (D18), in a new-launch development (no built_year, new-launch bias) priced ~21% below the $2,548 district median PSF. Outstanding MRT proximity and an apparent discount, but the missing built_year/appreciation data and new-launch pricing dynamics warrant caution.
history.rating_rationale: The 170m walk to Tampines West DTL is the best connectivity in the batch and a $2,004 PSF that is ~21% below the $2,548 district median looks compelling — but the district median is dominated by the surrounding new-launch comps (548 txns, new-launch bias), so part of that 'discount' reflects this specific unit/stack rather than a market gap, and a 1,227sqft 4BR is tight (likely a compact/dual-key layout). With no built_year and no project-specific appreciation rate to verify, plus a $2.46M absolute in the thinner band, I can't confidently call it a Buy. The Tampines Regional Centre + CRL location keeps it firmly Neutral with upside.
red_flags: Missing built_year and no URA appreciation rate — can't verify trajectory
New-launch bias in median; $2.46M is in the thinner buyer band
catalysts: 170m to Tampines West DTL — best connectivity in batch
Tampines Regional Centre + CRL/DTL hub, Jewel/Changi proximity
Apparent PSF discount vs district median if it holds
